title: Add a step-driven regression test for the acknowledgement-refresh versus send race in refresh_acknowledged_mailbox_wakeups
outcome: refresh_acknowledged_mailbox_wakeups snapshots the covered queued wakes and reads each boundary row off the state lock. Under the lock it then re-checks prompt id, message id and sequence. That re-check is the only guard against rewriting, as "Nothing is unread", a head that a concurrent send moved to a newer boundary N+1 with unread mail. A deterministic test drives that interleaving: take the covered snapshot, let a send advance the head, then apply. It asserts that the head keeps the N+1 unread text and that the public pending-prompt projection matches. This likely needs the refresh split into read and apply phases, as dispatch-time revalidation already is.
acceptance: A test takes the refresh's covered snapshot, then has a send advance the same mailbox's queued head to a newer boundary before the refresh applies. It asserts the head keeps the newer unread text and boundary, and that the pending-prompt projection matches. The test fails if the re-check under the lock is reduced to prompt-id matching only.
The full five-stage gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher finding.
